requirements.RCOI01: Skip only the newspaper candidate read when locked server facts rule out both race and flying-lap improvement; actual projections still decide possible winners.
requirements.RCOI02: Negotiate compact pending challenge results with the same current ownership/content/block checks, authoritative clocks/rewards/start budgets, per-stage counts and periodic full/terminal refreshes.
requirements.RCOI03: Negotiate terminal hot receipts, one coherent revisioned wallet per batch and optional authorized single-run challenge views; preserve archive/failure/identity/purchase recovery and ordinary-client fallbacks.

implementation.newspaper: Optional previous facts are supplied by the worker under its existing Player/Run locks. Both prior PBs must exist, race ticks must not improve, and all five laps must be present with no eligible flying-lap improvement before skipping. Other callers keep the existing query.
implementation.compact_pending: Shared snapshot_access runs the existing viewer-specific checks before representation selection. Only upload_pending/queued/verifying responses may be compact. Ordinary and terminal reads retain full snapshots. Clients merge whitelisted fields into the matching validated challenge, including each stage budget; the first eligible poll after ten seconds requests a full view. Existing retry backoff remains.
implementation.completion: completion=true opts run GET/status/wait/submission recovery into optional terminal-only hot receipt reads. Missing receipts always defer to the independent endpoint because a stale Run snapshot cannot prove no reward during archival. Balance/revision/owned items are read in one SQL statement. Batches send one wallet; single reads may include the currently authorized full challenge result.
implementation.failure_isolation: Read savepoints isolate optional enrichment failures. No archive object IO occurs in status enrichment. Missing or malformed enrichment keeps existing receipt/result fallbacks; reads never invoke reward writers.
implementation.native_consumers: Existing short-lived account-scoped run caches carry negotiated completion data. Wallets apply absolute snapshots monotonically; duplicates never add currency locally. Pending idempotent purchase recovery continues after a combined wallet read. Local safety changes invalidate cached challenge views, and scoped late replies cannot cross accounts.
implementation.retained: Full trajectory/build/ticket/rewind validation, earned rewards, background achievement refresh, weekly scoring, ghost persistence and series result-reference semantics remain.

protocol.defaults: No extra parameters means the previous complete response. A client without advertised version 1 uses previous reads.

evidence.limits: Single paired disposable SQLite/PosedVerifier fixture. Terminal decoded JSON grows slightly; fewer requests and compression reduce this fixture's encoded body totals. Counts are not a population load, latency, provider bill or physical-device result.

real_http.scope: Disposable loopback API/database and owned child processes, real development authentication and pinned native transport; host access used for Windows certificate-store reads.
